lines.text: This is ... the exclusion zone operation that cost us so much lives...
These personal items might shed a light on how our fellow Yinglungs disappeared...
Endmin, thank you for doing this for us. We will analyze the War Case data. And then...
...they'll be properly laid to rest...
This looks like an Yinglung item...
Start by recording the locations, yes... Salvaging requires a professional team and specialized gear. We don't have the people...
Endministrator? Sorry, I'm busy with something. Ahem. Just conduct the search according to plan.
Apologies, Endmin. I was handing out assignments to the team and didn't notice you back then. I'm Phrase and I answer straight to Arcane. I don't know if she or Summit mentioned it to you.

One of my teammates found something personal of a senior Yinglung... It's an Yinglung War Case. It contains biological data of the old Yinglungs, as well as movement routes they used and emergency encounters they engaged in.
We've been tasked to recover these personal belongings, but the exclusion zone is still a dangerous place. Since I don't have anyone to spare, I can only put this task on hold...
You're right... But objects from the exclusion zone tend to be tainted by the Blight Miasma...
The salvaging run needs specialized gear and professionals. I'm afraid only we Yinglungs or your Endfielders could pull it off.
We can definitely help. The aero-salvager sounds like a perfect tool for the job.
This is my mission, but I won't say no to help. Thank you again, Endmin. Your Endfielders are great help... These personal items offer more than just valuable knowledge for us...
We Yinglungs are still trying to scan for the lost items. Salvaging is difficult and we don't want to delay your other tasks, Endmin. If we were to locate one...
I'll help you salvage it. Don't worry. I'm glad to help.
Thank you... I'll sync you the coordinates of the lost items we located...
Thank you so much!
Yeah, that's it. You found it already... Gotta hand it to you, Endmin.
An Yinglung War Case storage chip, capable of automated as well as manual data storage. There's an encrypted sector... Hold on.
I applied to grant you access. You have the right to know since you are central to our operation.
Are these ... operational records of the Yinglungs?
I see another portion... It's a letter.
Penned by a senior Yinglung ... Ahem. Thank you for your help, Endmin.
Another item has been found. If we find anything, we'll sync you at once.
On behalf of all Yinglungs ... I thank you once again for your assistance...

Our predecessors left it for us...
Thank you. We'll run the analysis. Meanwhile, we also triangulated the signals of newly found Yinglung items. If you find anything...
What's this...? You actually salvaged it already. No wonder Task Leader Arcane trusts you so much.

If you see it...
Don't worry. I won't leave the lost items resting in the ruins.
On behalf of all Yinglungs ... I thank you once again for your assistance...
